### God Never Changes
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-03-03-04-1248567.html
Passage: Isaiah 54:10
Points:
- Human circumstances, bodily health, and everyday routines can change suddenly.
- While life fluctuates, God’s divine character and nature remain eternally constant.
- Even if mountains tremble, the Lord’s unfailing compassion and covenant of peace remain unbroken.
- Believers can find stability by anchoring their trust in God as their unwavering Rock.

### A Prayer for God's Strength When You Feel Under Attack
Author: Debbie McDaniel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-god-s-strength-when-you-feel-under-attack-your-daily-prayer-november-28-2016.html
Passage: Isaiah 54:17
Points:
- Believers encounter unexpected spiritual battles, insults, and seasons of affliction.
- God sees every trial and holds final authority over His children, not the accuser.
- Hostile schemes and cruel accusations cannot ultimately triumph over the power of God.
- Hardships serve to forge spiritual endurance and inner resilience.
- Christians can release their pain and rest in the Lord as their refuge and defender.

### How to Be Sure That ‘No Weapon Formed Against Me Shall Prosper’
Author: Heather Riggleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/no-weapon-formed-against-me-shall-prosper.html
Passage: Isaiah 54:17
Points:
- Christians experience real pain and adversity, but hostile weapons will not destroy them eternally.
- God's covenant promise ensures that evil blows will ultimately be transformed for His kingdom purposes.
- God provides a spiritual fortress of protection for all who make Him their refuge.
- Believers withstand attacks by immersing themselves in Scripture and utilizing the armor of God.
- Followers of Christ are sealed by the Holy Spirit, assuring final redemption and safety.
